mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25% (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0 (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 96.0) signals reduced manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to lower corporate earnings growth prospects.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 96.0 (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly payroll growth above 100,000 jobs (PAYEMS > 100,000) supports strong labor market conditions, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through elevated consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS > 100,000 (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher discount rates depress equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5 (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad economic weakness, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate investment outlook.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and HOUST fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.0%), S&P 500 forward returns become negative over the next 5 trading days due to heightened recession risks and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0 (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).
